title: Municipal Corporation of Delhi v. Subhagwanti

content.caseIdentity: Municipal Corporation of Delhi v. Subhagwanti, AIR 1966 SC 1750 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: The collapse of an 80-year-old clock tower in Chandni Chowk, Delhi, causing deaths of pedestrians, was governed by the doctrine of Res Ipsa Loquitur. The municipal corporation was held liable for failing to maintain and inspect the structure.
content.relevance: Leading Supreme Court precedent applying Res Ipsa Loquitur to urban infrastructure negligence.
